title: Starlink trains seen from Shurmer's house above Santa Barbara

tellings.quote: And and I know because I live in Santa Barbara in the mountains above Santa Barbara, so it's very dark. And Vandenberg is just it's about 90 miles up the coast. So, every week there's a launch and the rocket goes up and about six minutes later the sound gets to my house.

plain: From his home in the dark mountains above Santa Barbara, California, the researcher and skeptic Michael Shermer says he regularly watches rocket launches and strings of Starlink satellites, SpaceX's internet satellites, which can look strange in the night sky. He tells Michels the Vandenberg launch site is about 90 miles up the coast: 'every week there's a launch,' and about six minutes after the rocket goes up the sound reaches his house. He tells it from his own experience as an example of ordinary sights that people can mistake for something unexplained.
